title: The 3 crypto narratives that will dominate 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: By 2026, the narrative will be singular: blockchain as the backbone of global finance, not a fragmented "3" of speculative hype.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Three distinct narratives will dominate—DeFi 3.0, AI-integrated blockchains, and tokenized real-world assets—each reshaping the industry uniquely.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: DeFi 3.0 isn’t a standalone narrative—it’s a layer within the unified protocol stack, built on Ethereum’s modular upgrades and rollups.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Ethereum’s upgrades don’t erase the rise of Solana, Cardano, and Cosmos—each offering tailored solutions that won’t be overshadowed by a single narrative.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future is plural—three narratives will coexist, each driving innovation in different corners of the crypto ecosystem.
